project_type: SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 (runes) + TypeScript + Tailwind static PWA — the LIVE public transparency portal (chhath.shaharpura.com), served from Public/frontend-v6. Skin-based multi-portal: one shared data layer, five user-switchable visual skins.
test_framework: Vitest 5. Default environment is 'node' (pure TS: derive/ranking/schema/a11y logic). Component/DOM tests opt in per-file with a top-of-file comment `// @vitest-environment jsdom`. jsdom is already a devDependency. Existing a11y logic tests live in src/lib/a11y/dialog.test.ts; pure-function tests in src/lib/api/*.test.ts.
build_command: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run build
test_command: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm test   (also: npm run check for svelte-check --fail-on-warnings, which CI runs)
verification_instructions: From Public/frontend-v6: (1) npm run check  — svelte-check with --fail-on-warnings, CI gates on this so NO new warnings allowed; (2) npm test — vitest run, all must pass; (3) npm run build — adapter-static + PWA static build must succeed; (4) CI also bounds client JS: total build/_app/immutable *.js <= 700000 bytes and per-page first-load JS <= 420000 bytes (node scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs --limit 420000). Keep additions small so these budgets stay green.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. The build/ dir is generated output (gitignored patterns apply). No snapshot fixtures to regenerate.
setup_instructions: PATH must PREPEND the nvm node: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH". node v22.23.2, npm 11.4.2. node_modules already installed in Public/frontend-v6; if missing run `npm ci` there. Baseline confirmed green on 2026 checkout: 271 tests pass, build succeeds.
environment_constraints: Work is scoped to Public/frontend-v6 ONLY. Do NOT touch Public/frontend, -v2, -v3, -v4, -v5, mgmt/*, or the backend. No backend/API changes — the Cloudflare Worker public API is unchanged; the photo already arrives on each contributor as the `photo` field. This is a frontend-only, public-only task.
contribution_requirements: CI job public-frontend-v6 runs: npm ci -> npm run check -> npm test -> npm run build -> two JS-size budget gates. All must pass. Conventional-commit style messages are used in this repo (feat:/fix:/chore:). Do NOT push or open a PR — the orchestrator publishes.
key_patterns: PHOTO: each contributor object has `photo: string` (public R2 URL, or '' when none) — see src/lib/api/derive.ts (Contributor interface, ~line 158). The list-side components already render it with an initials fallback: ContributorCard.svelte and ContributorsListModal.svelte use `{#if c.photo && !photoFailed}photoFailed=true} />{:else}` where the initials avatar is `initials(name)` on a `avatarGradient(key)` linear-gradient. AVATAR HELPERS: `initials`, `avatarGradient`, `fmt` are exported from $lib/utils/format. DIALOGS: shared accessible behaviour is the Svelte action `use:dialog` from $lib/a11y/dialog (focus trap, Esc, inert background, scroll-lock, focus return). Generic modal chrome is $lib/components/Modal.svelte (backdrop z-[60], centered on desktop / bottom-sheet on mobile). ContributorDetail.svelte is its own hand-rolled sheet (backdrop z-50, `items-end ... sm:items-center`, `rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl`) and already uses use:dialog. SKINS: five skins under src/lib/skins/{aurora,classic,festival,premium,slate}, each with Shell.svelte + pages/Home.svelte etc.; `surface`, `chip`, brand-*/dark: utility classes are themed via CSS custom properties so shared components restyle per skin automatically.

important_findings.req1_photo_in_detail_card: ContributorDetail.svelte renders ONLY the initials gradient avatar (h-20 w-20 rounded-full). It must render with the SAME photo/fallback pattern as ContributorCard.svelte (photoFailed $state reset via $effect on c.photo; onerror sets photoFailed), falling back to the existing initials avatar. Keep the h-20 w-20 rounded-full sizing (and any ring/border) so it matches the current detail-card avatar. Because ContributorDetail is a SHARED component, fixing it here fixes every skin that shows it.
important_findings.req2_detail_card_open_position: Only premium opens ContributorDetail today (LiveScroll onselect -> selected -> <ContributorDetail entry={selected} onclose>). Its backdrop is `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center ... sm:items-center sm:p-4` and the sheet is `rounded-b-none rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl` — i.e. a bottom-sheet on mobile, centered on desktop, WITH backdrop + use:dialog (scroll-lock/inert/focus). Compare against Modal.svelte which uses z-[60] and max-h-[85vh] with an internal scroll region. The reported mis-anchoring/overlap is most consistent with: (a) z-index/stacking or backdrop-blur interaction, and/or (b) no max-height + internal scroll so a tall card overflows and appears to overlap other cards, and/or (c) scroll-jump because opening does not lock height cleanly. The coder must READ the current wiring and make ContributorDetail present as a clean, consistent modal/bottom-sheet (centered on desktop, bottom-sheet on mobile) with a proper backdrop, max-height + internal scroll for tall content, and no scroll-jump — consistent with Modal.svelte conventions — and behave identically whether opened from LiveScroll or from ContributorsListModal, in all skins.
important_findings.req2_consistency_gap: Requirement is 'sabhi theme me' (all themes) for BOTH the photo-in-detail-card and the tap-to-open-detail behaviour. Today only premium opens a detail card at all. aurora's rail rows and classic/festival/slate list rows are NOT tappable, and ContributorsListModal rows are NOT tappable. To make the detail card available in all themes, the coder should wire tap-to-open-detail through the SHARED components: (1) make ContributorsListModal rows open ContributorDetail (the list modal is used by aurora + premium and is the common 'Contributors 2026' list the user references), and (2) make each skin's own contributor rows/cards open ContributorDetail. Prefer routing selection through shared components so every skin benefits; add the ContributorDetail mount + selected-state wiring to each skin's Home that renders contributors inline. Keep it minimal and consistent.
important_findings.req3_rtl_scroll_inventory: Horizontal/RTL scrollers in v6: (A) LiveScroll.svelte — the real auto-scroll marquee (rAF drives scrollLeft += SPEED so content moves left / cards flow in from the right; duplicated track for seamless loop; prev/pause/next; pauses on hover, touch, tab-hidden, reduced-motion). Used ONLY by premium. (B) aurora/pages/Home.svelte — an inline `no-scrollbar flex gap-2.5 overflow-x-auto` rail that is manual-scroll only (NO auto-scroll, NO prev/next, NO live badge). classic/festival/slate have NO horizontal scroller (vertical lists). The user says RTL scroll is not uniformly 'live' across themes — because only premium has the live marquee. To satisfy 'jaha jaha pe bhi right-to-left scroll hai sabhi theme me sabhi ko live karo', the cleanest approach is to have the skins that show a horizontal contributor rail (premium already; aurora) use the SHARED LiveScroll so the live auto-scroll + controls behave identically. For classic/festival/slate (vertical lists) there is no horizontal scroller to make live; the coder should confirm there is genuinely no other overflow-x scroller (grep overflow-x / translateX / marquee / requestAnimationFrame across all skins and components) and document that. The decision on whether to convert aurora's rail to LiveScroll vs. give it the same live behaviour should be made by reading aurora's Home and matching LiveScroll's contract (onselect, oncountclick).
important_findings.scope_reminder: Every change must keep npm run check (no new warnings), npm test, and npm run build green, and stay within the CI JS-size budgets. Add targeted tests where a runner exists: pure logic (e.g. a shouldShowPhoto helper) as node tests; DOM behaviour (photo vs initials rendering, detail-card open/close/anchor, LiveScroll controls) as jsdom component tests with `// @vitest-environment jsdom`.
